title: MRIS Identity Report
description: Robot identity and capability information published on connection or when robot info changes.

uuid.description: RFC 4122 UUID identifying the robot. All subsequent messages must reference this UUID.

timestamp.description: Report timestamp in RFC 3339 date-time format

robotSerialNumber.description: Unique robot identifier that ideally can be physically linked to the AMR

baseRobotEnvelope.description: Physical footprint of the robot centered on current location

emergencyContactInformation.description: Emergency contact information, preferably a phone number

chargerType.description: Type of charger used by the robot

supportVendorName.description: Name of the vendor that supplied the robot

thumbnailImage.description: Link to a thumbnail graphic stored as PNG

cargoType.description: Description of cargo the robot can carry
